title: New Phyrexia/Event decks
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Scars of Mirrodin block event decks)

paragraphs.text: New Phyrexia has two monocolored event decks .
Rot from Within is an aggro green event deck with a focus on the infect mechanic.
The rares in this deck are Inkmoth Nexus , Putrefax , Putrefax , Green Sun's Zenith , Melira, Sylvok Outcast , Obstinate Baloth , and Obstinate Baloth .
War of Attrition is an aggro white event deck with a focus on equipment and the living weapon mechanic.
The rares in this deck are Kemba, Kha Regent , Mirran Crusader , Puresteel Paladin , Stoneforge Mystic , Stoneforge Mystic , Sword of Vengeance , and Bonehoard .
